muscle_arc.subject: hazel
muscle_arc.size_lineup: assets/muscle-size-lineup.png (sizes 1-6) — attach on stage-change panels, call out the number
muscle_arc.flavor: FMG muscle ONLY; natural skin tone (not red); athletic sheen; not fat; not giantess-magic

extra_lines: Hazel's muscle size is monotonic — each transformation panel is the same size or larger than before; never smaller.
It is MUSCLE growth, NOT fat — deep muscle separation, vascularity at high tiers; muscles a NATURAL healthy skin tone, never red/inflamed.
Brooke, Tiffany and the campus stay a FIXED normal size in every panel; ONLY Hazel changes (scale to stone steps / benches / the bullies).
Body-orientation variety is mandatory (L37): include back, profile, 3q-rear and over-shoulder views; attach the matching turnaround-sheet angle.
Transformation energy is cosmic blue-white with violet edges (identity FX).
Every character is an ADULT (21, university students).

lettering.bubble_style: classic black-and-white 2D comic balloons + yellow caption boxes + 2D SFX, bold black outline, ALL-CAPS Bangers-style comic font; flat 2D overlay only, photoreal DAZ3D everywhere else

camera_directive.rule: Cinematic, varied. Low-angle/worm's-eye for Hazel's growing scale (p05/p06/p11/p14); ECU for emotion (p04/p10); high-angle for Hazel's early weakness (p03); over-shoulder/back/profile for orientation variety (p02/p09/p12/p13/p15).
camera_directive.reference: User-supplied camera charts (shot sizes, camera angles, camera movement) — folded into shotlist per panel.
